caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with rounded corners, viewed from above, centered on a plain(off-white or beige) background. The tray has multiple borders, each with distinct colors and decorative patterns. The outermost border is a muted brown with a thin black outline, followed by a grayish band with black and floral designs placed at intervals, featuring small red accents. Inside this, there are several thinner concentric borders in shades of brown, gold, and green. The main surface of the tray is deep black or dark brown, surrounded by a wide band featuring ornate yellow-gold scrollwork with small, detailed floral motifs in red, pink, orange, and green at the corners. The overall composition is highly symmetrical with a focus on decorative and ornamental elements on the border, leaving the central area solid and unadorned.
title: Tin Tray
